item.title: San Angelo Rodeo Tickets Go on Sale Monday; Carnival Begins April 3
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Tickets for the San Angelo Stock Show and Rodeo go on sale online at 10 a.m. Monday, with the event's Carnival set to begin April 3 and run through April 19 at the fairgrounds, coinciding with the rodeo. The carnival will feature rides, food vendors, and attractions, including Ferris wheels, funnel cakes, and roller coasters. Organizers expect close to 150,000 visitors over the 17-day event. Learn More Here.

item.title: Wall Girls Lock Down Central Heights to Bring Home Third State Title
item.description: SAN ANTONIO, TX — The No. 1-ranked Wall girls basketball team completed its remarkable season with a 49-34 win over No. 24 Central Heights on Friday in the Class 3A Division II state final at the Alamodome in San Antonio.It was the third state title in program history as the Lady Hawks joined the 2014 and '16 teams.Wall sophomore Jewels Johnson was named the state final MVP after scoring nine points to go along with 10 rebounds, three steals, three assists and a block. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Man Arrested in Kerr County After I-10 Traffic Stop Yields Drugs, Gun, Cash

item.title: Vehicle Crashes Into Tree On U.S. 277
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — One person was taken to the hospital with minor injuries after a vehicle crashed into a tree near the intersection of South U.S. 277 and Reese Road around 3 p.m. Friday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Water Valley’s Season Ends With Regional Final Loss to Munday
item.description: ABILENE, TX — For the second consecutive year, the Water Valley boys basketball team lost in the last seconds of the regional final.The No. 19-ranked Wildcats battled back from an 11-point deficit in the fourth quarter and had three chances at game-tying 3-pointers, but none of them found their mark in a 52-47 loss to the No. 6 Munday Moguls on Friday at Abilene Christian University’s Moody Coliseum. Learn More Here.

item.title: Sexual Assault of a Child, DWI 3rd or More, and Theft of Property Lead Bookings
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Corrections officers at the Tom Green County Jail report 21 bookings in the past 24 hours, led by arrests for sexual assault of a child, driving while intoxicated third or more, and theft of property <$2,500 2/more previous convictions.There are currently 496 individuals booked in the Tom Green County Jail. Learn More Here.

item.title: Storm Chances Continue Through Midweek
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Thunderstorms delivered heavy rain, small hail and gusty winds across West Central Texas early Saturday, with ongoing activity along a cold front expected to persist for a few more hours before storm chances continue through midweek. Learn More Here.
